scripts.obs:up: test -f docs/observability/.env || cp docs/observability/.env.example docs/observability/.env; (docker run -d --name phoenix-obs -p 6006:6006 arizephoenix/phoenix:latest || docker start phoenix-obs); docker compose -f docs/observability/docker-compose.langfuse.yml -p langfuse --env-file docs/observability/.env up -d
